BiblicalUsage: This word is expectation, a looking for, and it occurs once, in the warning of Hebrews. For those who sin wilfully after receiving the knowledge of the truth, there remains a certain fearful looking for of judgement and fiery indignation. The word is dread, the expectation of a judgement that is already certain.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the fearful expectation of judgement is real, because Hebrews says it plainly, and it is meant to drive me back to the sacrifice while there is still time.
RelatedTopics: Judgment; Fear of the Lord; Repentance
